push.title: W 1-0 vs UK Chargers | You: 7.6 (worst match performance)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.6. We'll be curious about it, not cruel about it.

DID WELL
+ 2 key passes. You were the playmaker, the matchmaker and the good-time maker.
+ A goal against UK Chargers, your 5th straight match scoring. Right place, right time, right foot.
+ 2 shots on target lifted you +0.1. Like a tailwind on a bike ride.
+ Took UK Chargers down 1-0. That's growth.

WORK ON
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). Here's how: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts. Patience, partner.
- 71% passing (17 of 24). For next time: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too. You know you can.
- Rating came in 0.5 below what your on-ball stats earned. Here's the play: Your rating came in lower than your stats say, and that gap is off-ball: positioning, interceptions, blocks.
- You and PhogsToffees, same forcing passes homework. Partners: give each other short options.
- 0.7 below your typical game. Next one's the bounce-back.

Quick drill: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.

One thought for the road, BellyTb1: Don't count the days; make the days count. Then count the goals.

Tomorrow's a new chance. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 1-0 vs UK Chargers | You: 6.7 (worst match performance)
push.body:
A 6.7, PhogsToffees. We all get knocked down. The trick is getting up a little smarter.

DID WELL
+ BellyTb1 scored and you helped make it happen. Keep feeding those runs.
+ 1 key pass chipped in +0.2. Every bit helps.
+ 1 shot on target delivered +0.1. Keep it up.
+ Won 1-0 against UK Chargers. Feel good about it tonight.

WORK ON
- 71% passing (20 of 28). Little adjustment: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough. Next match, nail it.
- You and BellyTb1, same lesson: forcing passes. Same answer: give each other short options.
- 1.5 under average. That's a blip. Blips blip.
- A 6.7 ranks as your worst match performance. Not who you are, just where you were tonight.
- Shots: 1. Respectable. Top-quarter forwards get to 3+, and you've got it in you.

Training note: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.

PhogsToffees, write this on your hand if you have to: Be curious about your game, not cruel to it.

Keep your head up and your feet moving. - Coach Lasso
